Newspapers.meaning: A person who writes news stories for newspapers, magazines, etc.
Newspapers.example: The reporter covered the latest news from the war zone.

Newspapers.meaning: A journalist who reports from a particular place or on a particular subject.
Newspapers.example: The foreign correspondent reported on the election results.

Newspapers.meaning: A piece of news published by a newspaper or broadcast by a television or radio station in advance of its rivals.
Newspapers.example: The newspaper had a scoop on the celebrity's wedding.

Newspapers.meaning: A notice of a death, especially in a newspaper, typically including a brief biography of the deceased.
Newspapers.example: The obituary highlighted his contributions to the community.

Newspapers.meaning: The way in which text and pictures are set out on a page.
Newspapers.example: The new layout of the newspaper made it easier to read.

Newspapers.meaning: The latest time or date by which something should be completed.
Newspapers.example: The journalist worked late to meet the deadline.

Newspapers.meaning: A journalist who writes regularly for a newspaper or magazine.
Newspapers.example: The columnist offered insights into the local economy.

Newspapers.meaning: The title of a newspaper or magazine at the head of the front or editorial page.
Newspapers.example: The masthead featured the newspaper's new logo.

Newspapers.meaning: An official statement issued to newspapers giving information on a particular matter.
Newspapers.example: The company issued a press release announcing the new product.

Newspapers.meaning: A title or brief explanation accompanying an illustration, photo, or diagram.
Newspapers.example: The caption under the photo read: "Local hero saves child."

Newspapers.meaning: Involves detailed and careful examination or inquiry.
Newspapers.example: The investigative report uncovered corruption in the local government.

Newspapers.meaning: A person, book, document, etc., that provides information.
Newspapers.example: The reporter cited an anonymous source for the information.

Newspapers.meaning: A published false statement is damaging to a person's reputation.
Newspapers.example: The newspaper was sued for libel after publishing the false allegations.

Newspapers.meaning: The introductory section of a news story that is intended to entice the reader to read the full story.
Newspapers.example: The lead captured the essence of the breaking news.

Newspapers.meaning: The reporting of a particular important event or subject.
Newspapers.example: The newspaper's coverage of the election was comprehensive.

Newspapers.meaning: A particular version or issue of a newspaper.
Newspapers.example: The evening edition included updates on the day's events.

Newspapers.meaning: A notice or announcement in a public medium promoting a product, service, or event.
Newspapers.example: The newspaper contained several advertisements for local businesses.

Newspapers.meaning: A person who works as a writer or journalist without being employed by a particular company.
Newspapers.example: The freelancer contributed articles to multiple newspapers.

Newspapers.meaning: A line at the beginning of a news article that gives the date and place of origin.
Newspapers.example: The dateline read: "June 26, 2024 - New York, NY."

Newspapers.meaning: A headline in large type extending across the width of the page.
Newspapers.example: The banner headline announced the historic victory.

Personality.example: She has an amiable nature and gets along with everyone.

Personality.meaning: Wishing to do what is right, especially to do one's work well
Personality.example: He is a conscientious student who always submits his assignments on time.
His gregarious personality makes him popular at social gatherings.
Her impulsive decisions often lead to unexpected adventures.
The meticulous artist spent hours perfecting her painting.

Personality.meaning: Slow to reveal emotions or opinions
Personality.example: He is reserved and prefers listening over speaking.
Her tenacious attitude helped her overcome many obstacles.
His altruistic nature drives him to volunteer regularly.
The boisterous children filled the house with laughter.
She appreciated his candid feedback on her performance.
Her diligent efforts resulted in outstanding grades.

Personality.meaning: Showing an ability to understand others' feelings
Personality.example: An empathetic leader understands the team’s struggles.
His fickle behaviour makes it hard to predict his actions.

Personality.meaning: Having a modest or low opinion of oneself
Personality.example: Despite his success, he remains humble and approachable.

Personality.meaning: Able to understand or know something without reasoning
Personality.example: She has an intuitive sense of people's needs.
His jovial manner made the party more enjoyable.

Personality.meaning: Having a kind and sympathetic nature
Personality.example: The kind-hearted nurse comforted the patients.
A loyal friend is always there in times of need.

Personality.meaning: Showing a lack of experience, wisdom, or judgment
Personality.example: Her naïve view of the world often leads to misunderstandings.

Personality.meaning: Hopeful and confident about the future
Personality.example: An optimistic outlook can improve your overall well-being.

Personality.meaning: Dealing with things sensibly and realistically
Personality.example: Her pragmatic approach to problems ensures efficient solutions.
His quirky sense of humour makes him stand out.

Personality.meaning: Able to withstand or recover quickly from difficult conditions
Personality.example: Her resilient spirit helped her overcome the challenges.
His sincere apology mended their relationship.

Personality.meaning: Having or showing sensitivity in dealing with others
Personality.example: Her tactful comments diffused the tense situation.
His unassuming nature makes him approachable and likable.
Her vivacious personality brightens up the room.

Personality.meaning: Showing or characterised by quick and inventive verbal humour
Personality.example: His witty remarks often leave everyone in stitches.

Personality.meaning: Having or showing great energy or enthusiasm in pursuit of a cause
Personality.example: The zealous activist worked tirelessly for the environment.
